source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 10
statement: Memberships are not exchanged between instances: each holds its own, for cosec.authorization.membership.ttl, and none is written to Redis; what crosses is their invalidation, a frame on the deployment's membership channel, which an instance of either version applies to its own copy.
guards: compat:LocalStateCompatTest#an invalidation either version publishes drops the other's copy of a membership
